items.title: Kore – local AI memory layer with Ebbinghaus forgetting curve
items.raw_excerpt:
I built Kore because every AI memory tool I found either required cloud APIs, was too heavy, or stored everything forever with no pruning. Kore is different:
- Memory decay based on the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve — memories fade unless retrieved, with half-life based on importance (7 days for casual notes, 1 year for critical info)
- Auto-importance scoring locally — no LLM call needed
- Semantic search in 50+ languages — local sentence-transformers, zero API calls
- Memory compression — auto-merges similar memories
- Agent namespace isolation — multi-agent safe
- Runs fully offline — SQLite + FTS5, FastAPI, no external services pip install kore-memory[semantic] then kore to start. Would love feedback on the decay formula and whether the Ebbinghaus approach makes sense for long-running ag

- Auto-importance scoring locally — no LLM call needed
- Semantic search in 50+ languages — local sentence-transformers, zero API calls
- Memory compression — auto-merges similar memories
- Agent namespace isolation — multi-agent safe
- Runs fully offline — SQLite + FTS5, FastAPI, no external services pip install kore-memory[semantic] then kore to start. Would love feedback on the decay formula and whether the Ebbinghaus approach makes sense for long-running ag

items.title: I built a pre-push safety net for AI-generated code
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, I am sharing Ship Safe ( https://github.com/asamassekou10/ship-safe ), an open-source tool I created to help developers catch security risks locally before they end up in a public repository. Like many of us, I have been leaning heavily on AI code generation lately. It is incredible for velocity, but it has a dangerous habit of hallucinating credentials, hardcoding sensitive configurations, or spitting out insecure boilerplate. My wake-up call was almost pushing a live Stripe key to a public repo. That moment of panic made me realize I needed a reliable local checkpoint. I built Ship Safe so it is not just a simple key checker. It is meant to be a comprehensive safety net for your code. It scans for hardcoded secrets, misconfigured environment setups, and general insecure patterns.

items.title: How AI is affecting productivity and jobs in Europe
items.raw_excerpt: Artificial intelligence promises to reshape economies worldwide, but firm-level evidence on its effects in Europe remains scarce. This column uses survey data to examine how AI adoption affects productivity and employment across more than 12,000 European firms. The authors find that AI adoption increases labour productivity levels by 4% on average in the EU, with no evidence of reduced employment in the short run. The productivity benefits, however, are unevenly distributed.

items.title: 千问3.5引爆全球AI产业链，英伟达、华为昇腾、AMD、苹果等第一时间适配
items.raw_excerpt: 千问3.5除夕开源发布，在全球AI产业链掀起热潮。截至2月18日，记者发现，英伟达、AMD、苹果公司等国际硬件厂商，已实现开发框架乃至芯片层对Qwen3.5的适配；华为昇腾、摩尔线程、沐曦、海光等国产GPU和平台均官宣Day 0 适配千问3.5新模型。千问3.5总参数3970亿仅激活170亿，性能超越上代万亿参数模型Qwen3-Max，部署显存占用大降60%，推理最大吞吐提升至19倍。基于底层模型架构创新，Qwen3-Plus在阿里云百炼API价格低至每百万Token0.8元，以不到5%的低价格获得媲美Gemini 3的高性能。 千问3.5以小胜大，创下大模型效率和性价比新高，又因其开源而一举成为三方平台争先抢上的最热门模型。国家超算互联网平台、曙光云、算能Sophnet、OpenRouter、Together AI、Ollama、ZenMux、Novita AI、Poe等国内外平台，均已第一时间上线Qwen3.5模型，对外提供API服务或体验入口。

title_i18n.zh: 千问3.5引爆全球AI产业链，英伟达、华为昇腾、AMD、苹果等第一时间适配
title_i18n.en: Qwen 3.5 has ignited the global AI industry chain, with immediate adaptations from NVIDIA, Huawei Ascend, AMD, Apple, and others.
title_i18n.es: Qwen 3.5 desencadena la cadena industrial global de IA, con adaptaciones inmediatas de Nvidia, Huawei Ascend, AMD, Apple y otros.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 千问3.5除夕开源发布，在全球AI产业链掀起热潮。截至2月18日，记者发现，英伟达、AMD、苹果公司等国际硬件厂商，已实现开发框架乃至芯片层对Qwen3.5的适配；华为昇腾、摩尔线程、沐曦、海光等国产GPU和平台均官宣Day 0 适配千问3.5新模型。千问3.5总参数3970亿仅激活170亿，性能超越上代万亿参数模型Qwen3-Max，部署显存占用大降60%，推理最大吞吐提升至19倍。基于底层模型架构创新，Qwen3-Plus在阿里云百炼API价格低至每百万Token0.8元，以不到5%的低价格获得媲美Gemini 3的高性能。 千问3.5以小胜大，创下大模型效率和性价比新高，又因其开源而一举成为三方平台争先抢上的最热门模型。国家超算互联网平台、曙光云、算能Sophnet、OpenRouter、Together AI、Ollama、ZenMux、Novita AI、Poe等国内外平台，均已第一时间上线Qwen3.5模型，对外提供API服务或体验入口。
excerpt_i18n.en: Qwen3.5 was open-sourced and released on New Year's Eve, sparking a global wave of excitement across the AI industry chain. As of February 18, it has been observed that international hardware manufacturers such as NVIDIA, AMD, and Apple have adapted their development frameworks and even chip layers to support Qwen3.5. Domestic GPUs and platforms, including Huawei Ascend, Moore Threads, MetaX, and Hygon, have officially announced Day 0 adaptation for the new Qwen3.5 model. With a total of 397 billion parameters, only 17 billion are activated, yet its performance surpasses the previous trillion-parameter model Qwen3-Max. Deployment GPU memory usage has been reduced by 60%, and maximum inference throughput has increased by up to 19 times. Thanks to innovations in the underlying model architecture, Qwen3-Plus is priced as low as 0.8 yuan per million tokens on Alibaba Cloud's Bailian API, delivering high performance comparable to Gemini 3 at less than 5% of the cost. Qwen3.5 achieves greater efficiency and cost-effectiveness with fewer parameters, setting new benchmarks in the large model landscape. Its open-source nature has made it the most sought-after model for third-party platforms. Both domestic and international platforms, including the National Supercomputing Internet Platform, Sugon Cloud, Sophon's Sophnet, OpenRouter, Together AI, Ollama, ZenMux, Novita AI, and Poe, have promptly integrated Qwen3.5, offering API services or access points for user experience.
excerpt_i18n.es: Qwen3.5 se lanzó de código abierto en Nochevieja, desatando una ola de entusiasmo en la cadena industrial global de IA. Hasta el 18 de febrero, se ha observado que fabricantes internacionales de hardware como NVIDIA, AMD y Apple han logrado adaptar sus marcos de desarrollo e incluso sus chips a Qwen3.5. Por su parte, GPUs y plataformas nacionales como Huawei Ascend, Moore Threads, MetaX y Hygon han anunciado oficialmente la adaptación Day 0 al nuevo modelo Qwen3.5. Con un total de 397 mil millones de parámetros, de los cuales solo 17 mil millones están activos, Qwen3.5 supera en rendimiento al modelo anterior Qwen3-Max, que tenía billones de parámetros, reduciendo la ocupación de memoria de despliegue en un 60% y aumentando el rendimiento máximo de inferencia hasta 19 veces. items.title: Unifying Ranking and Generation in Query Auto-Completion via Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Multi-Objective Alignment
items.raw_excerpt:
Query Auto-Completion (QAC) is a critical feature of modern search systems that improves search efficiency by suggesting completions as users type. However, existing approaches face fundamental challenges: traditional retrieve-and-rank pipelines have poor long-tail coverage and require extensive feature engineering, while recent generative methods suffer from hallucination and safety risks. We present a unified framework that reformulates QAC as end-to-end list generation through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and multi-objective Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).
